# Kill switch design numbers (generated by design_calc.py)

## Magnet and sensors

- Magnet N52 diameter 15 x 10 mm, Hall die 9.5 mm from the magnet face.
- Field at the Hall sensor: 103.9 mT with the weakest N52 (A3144 operate point max about 35 mT): margin 3.0x.
- Reed 12 mm off axis sees 30.8 mT along its length; centred on the axis it would see 1.6e-07 mT (field lines cancel), so it must sit off axis.
- Hall (A3144) releases at the latest 29 mm out, the reed at the latest 80 mm. Park the plug at least 120 mm away.

| Plug pulled out (mm) | Field at Hall (mT) |
|---|---|
| 0 | 106.151 |
| 2 | 76.212 |
| 5 | 48.607 |
| 10 | 25.613 |
| 15 | 14.998 |
| 20 | 9.494 |
| 30 | 4.482 |
| 40 | 2.455 |
| 60 | 0.967 |
| 80 | 0.475 |
| 100 | 0.267 |
| 150 | 0.09 |

Stray field of a 150 A cable at the sensor:

| Distance | Single wire | + and - paired |
|---|---|---|
| 2 cm | 1.50 mT | 0.900 mT |
| 5 cm | 0.60 mT | 0.144 mT |
| 10 cm | 0.30 mT | 0.036 mT |
| 20 cm | 0.15 mT | 0.009 mT |

## Losses and temperature

- 8 MOSFETs in parallel, hot: 116 uOhm. At 100 A: 1.16 W in the MOSFETs (0.17 W each), 2.4 W for the whole board.
- At 150 A: 2.64 W in the MOSFETs (0.40 W each), junction about 62 C with the board at 60 C.
- Board rise at 100 A continuous: 8 C in still air, 6 C with an aluminium spreader to the hull.

| Switch at 100 A | Heat (W) |
|---|---|
| 3x IRF4905 P-FET (20 mOhm each) | 66.7 |
| 4x IRLZ44N style N-FET (22 mOhm) | 55.0 |
| this design 8x IPT007N06N | 1.2 |
| 100 A contactor coil (typ. 12 V, 0.4-0.8 A) | 7.2 |

## Controller (LM5060) settings

- UVLO 9.4 V rising / 8.1 V falling. OVP (6S default) 32 V / 28.2 V; 4S option 20.2 V / 17.8 V.
- Short-circuit (VDS) trip 59-78 mV: 417 A or more; a 150 A burst gives only 21 mV.
- Start-up check after 134-235 ms; fault timer 85 ms.

## Pre-charge and short detection

- Pre-charge through 11 Ohm: 1.5 A (4S) / 2.3 A (6S) instead of about 644 A when switching hard.
- Main MOSFETs close only when VOUT > 0.502 x VIN - 0.47 V.
- Shorted thruster bus: pre-charge stops after 9.4 ms at 4S (0.24 J), 6.2 ms at 6S (0.36 J); the main MOSFETs never turn on.
- Pre-charge is also stopped if VOUT has not reached VOUT > 0.453 x VIN - 0.47 V (an ESC drawing current, a soft short).
- Turn-off with the PNP: Miller plateau about 18 us, 8.5 A/us at 150 A (8.5 V on 1 uH, 22 mJ in the MOSFETs) instead of 1.0 ms with the controller's 2.2 mA alone.

## Timing

- Kill: about 5 ms after the magnet leaves. A gap shorter than 0.9 ms is ignored. Re-arm waits 1.1 s.

## Wiring impedance

- Battery lead 1 uH and 4000 uF of ESC capacitance: Z0 15.8 mOhm, loop resistance 26 mOhm, damping 0.83.
- Energy left in the leads at a 150 A kill: 11.2 mJ (battery side), 5.6 mJ (thruster side), taken by the TVS diodes (SMDJ26A on VIN, SMCJ26A on VOUT).

## Magnet plug on a vertical wall

- Plug about 29 g, weight 0.29 N. Pull-out force designed at 10-20 N: 35x its own weight, against 1.4 N at 5 g vibration and 1.2 N of water drag at 1.5 m/s.
